# Android genesis_plus_gx 1.7.4-f27655b

Four retained, unmodified official Libretro archives. `provenance.json` records
original URLs, immutable corresponding source, archive/source/library hashes,
ELF identities, Android build recipe and inspected system dependencies.
`notices/` retains upstream license notices, including pinned submodule notices
where applicable. The upstream license prohibits commercial use/distribution;
component terms remain applicable. No reproduced build-environment claim is made.

Only explicit Broomm Setup downloads this version into external RetroArch.
Recipes must pin the retained artifact commit. Existing cores, standalone
configuration and profile progress are preserved.
